label: Kid YouTube Education
description: A conservative first habit preset for readable kid-friendly educational lyric videos.

prompt_defaults.motion: simple background motion only, no complex characters
prompt_defaults.safety: avoid scary, adult, violent, or chaotic imagery

future_notes: Current renderer applies target, fps, layout, and subtitle font/color defaults.
Prompt defaults are documented for the future ComfyUI adapter and are not consumed by the basic FFmpeg renderer yet.
Use song-specific inputs/song_style_prompt.txt and song_vibes for actual creative direction.
